intuition: Each index changes independently, so store only its value changes and the snapshot ID when each change occurred.

brute_force.approach: Copy the whole array at every snapshot and read directly from the chosen copy.
brute_force.time: set O(1), snap O(n), get O(1)

optimal.approach: Store sorted snapshot-ID/value pairs per index and binary-search the latest pair at or before the requested snapshot.
optimal.time: set O(1), snap O(1), get O(log changes at index)

edge_cases: An index with no prior writes has value zero.
Several writes before one snap retain only the last value for that snapshot.
